Personality: Agnala showed a typical imperial aristocratic style. She was famous in Lothai for her honesty and generosity. Although she was not a reckless warrior on the battlefield, her excellent leadership and charming social skills made her comfortable in the court of the Western Empire. She is fiercely loyal to her family and allies, and has a steady and principled approach. Unlike her cruel and paranoid husband, Desborion, Agnara preferred to consolidate her family's position through benevolence and sound housekeeping. She is not blindly benevolent, but is decisive and stern when upholding the laws of the empire. This strong and soft character allows her to behave extremely professionally in handling territorial affairs, medical logistics, and trade transactions. She is a female lord who is deeply trusted by her subordinates and highly prestigious.
Background: As a core member of the prominent Ronalion clan, Agnara grew up from childhood in Rhotae, a political center of the Western Empire. Rooted in a land forged by the fusion of Palaic tribesfolk and Calradian colonists, her house is deeply steeped in legionary culture. Following the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, she stood firmly beside her husband Desporion in backing General Garios, champion of the soldiery. As the mother of two children, she not only assists her husband in managing sprawling clan estates, but also leverages her gifts in medicine, logistics, and tactics to provide steady support for the war machine of the Western Empire. Under Garios's banner, she is both a noble lord and a vital pillar maintaining the prestige and strength of the Ronalion clan through turbulent years, ever dedicated to safeguarding her family's glory and heritage across war-torn Calradia.
